C0163.title: Tech-Savvy Individual Sentenced for Developing and Selling Game Cheats, Illegally Profiting Over One Million Yuan
C0163.summary: In November 2023, China Court reported a case decided by the Weidu District People’s Court in Xuchang, Henan. Defendant Zou sold and customized game cheat programs for a game studio from 2021 onward, enabling the studio to disrupt game programs and increase the efficiency of earning in-game gold. From July 2021 to July 2022, Zou earned 1,035,103 yuan. The court convicted him of providing programs or tools for intruding into or illegally controlling computer information systems and sentenced him to three years in prison, suspended for five years, with an 80,000 yuan fine and confiscation of illegal gains.
